description: Barnegat Bay Climate Change Adaptation Strategy Development is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); Barnegat Bay Partnership; EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. The Barnegat Bay Partnership (BBP) was one of the first recipients of a grant from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s Climate Ready Estuaries Program. BBP has used this and other funding to undertake several climate adaptation initiatives led by a stakeholder working group. Coverage: Lacey Township, NJ (2009). The toolkit gives Lacey Township, NJ as the location, 2009 as the year and 9 years as the duration. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
